feed.title: Depots: Theft-Proof, Self-Custodial Bitcoin For Billions Of Users

entry.title: Depots: Theft-Proof, Self-Custodial Bitcoin For Billions Of Users
entry.summary:
The discussion raises significant concerns regarding the expiry requirements in digital wallets, particularly focusing on scenarios where users might face accessibility issues. The problem emerges when a user loses their phone, remains offline for an extended period, or simply misses reminders to transfer their funds before they expire. These situations pose a risk of losing access to funds stored digitally.
One potential solution explored is the automatic transfer of funds to a new depot well before the expiry deadline. This preemptive action could safeguard against the possibility of fund expiration due to unforeseen circumstances. However, implementing such a feature requires careful consideration of the backup information necessary to re-establish account ownership and access after a device is lost. This backup process must be robust enough to ensure security yet straightforward enough to facilitate ease of recovery by the rightful owner.
